correctness.rationale: For each left-of-peak position, compare maximizing centered ball with ball one vertex to the right and radius one less: only low left-end vertices are removed; their values cannot exceed the old ball mean, so Mf increases. Reflect for right half; Mf(k)=H. Prefix and suffix ball averages give endpoint gains (H-a)/k and (H-b)/(n-k+1). The variation telescopes and proves both displayed bounds; single-spike inputs give equality. Independent exact enumeration for n=3..6 with values 0,1,2 corroborates the algebra but does not replace the proof.
